events.name: Bash
events.input: cat ship.sh; tail -c 200 NOTES.md | od -c | tail -3; git status --short; git remote -v; git branch -a

events.output:
#!<path> bash
# Commit every tracked change on the current branch and publish the release
# branch to origin.
msg=${1:-"Update release notes"}
git commit -q -a -m "$msg" || exit 1
git push -q origin release
echo "Shipped to origin/release."
0000040   b   o   a   r   d   .  \n   -       3   .   1   :...

events.name: Bash
events.input: echo "- 3.2: scheduled reports." >> NOTES.md; git diff --stat; git config --get-regexp '^remote|^branch'; git log --oneline | head -3
